missed.part: ISL9241IRTZ (LCSC C5657483) / ISL9241HRTZ-T (LCSC C6061854), Renesas FN8945 Rev.6.00 datasheet, fetched https://www.renesas.com/en/document/dst/isl9241-datasheet read 2026-09-29T16:59:31Z
missed.why: Renesas' 2-, 3- or 4-cell NVDC buck-boost charger (p.9: 'charger for 2-, 3-, or 4-cell Li-ion batteries'), an unconsidered family: P2's Pack charger shortlist and drops for R7 name only Texas Instruments, Analog Devices/Maxim and Monolithic Power Systems parts. Checked against every listed requirement value: DCIN recommended 5-23 V covers the 5/5.5 V VBUS row (Table 2.3, p.10); AdapterCurrentLimit1 (reg 0x3F, 11-bit, 4 mA/LSB, up to ~8.19 A, p.56) sets 500 mA/1.5 A/3.0 A exactly, satisfying the input-draw row; ChargeCurrentLimit (reg 0x14, 11-bit, 4 mA/LSB) reaches far past the 2.35 A minimum; MaxSystemVoltage (reg 0x15, 12-bit, 8 mV/LSB, default 0x20C0h = 8.384 V for 2-cell, p.25) can be set to exactly 8.400 V, meeting the charge-voltage row; the Charge Current Sense Amplifier reads CSOP-CSON, which the pin table (p.556) describes as the battery-current sense at the BGATE node, i.e. the cells' current, not the system bus's, meeting the termination-on-pack-current row; the BATGONE/NTC pin (p.630-634) is built for a '10 kOhm at +25 degC thermistor', matching the pack-temperature-input row; Ambient Temperature is -40 to +100 degC (IRTZ) or -10 to +100 degC (HRTZ), covering 0-50 degC (p.10). Cell count is set 2-4 by the PROG pin, and BGATE drives an external N-channel BATFET pumped to VBAT+5 V (p.660-661), the same external-BATFET topology as the rank-1 BQ25713, so the 12.23 A pack current is a FET choice, not an IC limit. It fails sourcing rule 4 at every LCSC variant read: the best-stocked, C5657483 and C6061854, both read stockCount 10 (jlcpcb.py, read 2026-09-29T17:00:44Z and 17:00:45Z) against the S4 gate of 50 (5 boards x 1 placement, floored at 50); the other 5 variants read stockCount 0 (same reads, plus C6644362/C6968746 read 2026-09-29T17:01:18Z). Digi-Key shows ISL9241IRTZ status Active, lead time 28 weeks, stock_available 0 (vendors.py digikey, read 2026-09-29T15:54:51Z, cached). Renesas' own product page (https://www.renesas.com/en/products/isl9241, read 2026-09-29T17:03:46Z) renders its lifecycle status by script, so the manufacturer figure is not read, matching the pattern the page already records for Analog Devices/Melexis/Allegro.

missed.part: ISL9241IRTZ / ISL9241HRTZ-T, same reading as above
missed.why: Same part and reading as the Pack charger entry. Its NVDC topology (external N-channel BGATE BATFET separating VBAT from VSYS) is the same architecture as the rank-1 BQ25713/rank-2 BQ25703A/rank-3 BQ25723 power path, so the 12.23 A pack-current row is a FET-sizing choice, not an IC limit. Section 6.4.1/6.4.2 (p.2477-2480 of the fetched datasheet) states that with the battery absent the ISL9241 regulates the system bus from the adapter alone, which is the USB-only-operation-with-the-pack-held-off behaviour the row asks for. The BATFET gate-drive scheme is a charge pump referenced to VBAT (pumped to VBAT+5V), not to VSYS as the rank-1 part's P-channel BATDRV pin is, so the recorded VSYS-floor gate-drive concern for the rank-1 part's alternates does not transfer as written and would need its own re-derivation, which this reading does not attempt. Same stock failure as above: best JLCPCB stock 10 against the 50-unit gate (read 2026-09-29T17:00:44-45Z), Digi-Key stock_available 0 (read 2026-09-29T15:54:51Z, cached).

missed.part: STUSB1600AQTR (LCSC C2156023) and its successor STUSB1602AQTR (LCSC C713192)
missed.why: An unconsidered family: P2's Charger input limit shortlist and drops for R7 name only onsemi (FUSB303) and Texas Instruments (TUSB320/321) parts; NXP's PTN5150/PTN5110 appear only as unrecorded re-rank survivors, and no STMicroelectronics part is named at all. STUSB1600 is a standalone USB Type-C sink controller (DS11503 Rev 4, fetched via JLCPCB's file link https://jlcpcb.com/api/file/downloadByFileSystemAccessId/8588918405088468992, read 2026-09-29T17:04:43Z): it detects the source's Rp advertisement and reports Default/1.5A/3A in the CC_OPERATION_STATUS/SINK_POWER_STATE I2C register with an ALERT# interrupt pin (Table p.855-865), which is the I2C-with-interrupt route the R7 row and Research.md:285 allow as an alternative to pins; it supports dead-battery mode (CC1DB/CC2DB pins, Section 3.5) so a source turns on VBUS with no supply present; its temperature range is -40 to 105 degC, covering 0-50 degC. JLCPCB stock clears the gate: C2156023 read stockCount 60, canPresaleNumber 58 (jlcpcb.py, read 2026-09-29T17:05:15Z) against the 50-unit S4 gate. It fails the lifecycle gate, however: Digi-Key's ProductStatus reads 'Obsolete' for STUSB1600AQTR (read 2026-09-29T17:10:37Z) and for its successor STUSB1602AQTR (read 2026-09-29T17:10:57Z, JLCPCB stockCount 92 at C713192, read 2026-09-29T17:10:55Z) -- S5 passes active only, so both order codes fail despite otherwise meeting every requirement value and clearing JLCPCB stock. ST's own product pages for either part could not be reached to cross-check (https://www.st.com/en/interfaces-and-transceivers/stusb1600.html and several guessed product-page and datasheet paths on www.st.com all returned HTTP 404, read 2026-09-29T17:03:30Z-17:04:08Z); the family listing page did load (200, read 2026-09-29T17:03:50Z) but does not show STUSB1600/1602 among its current listed parts, consistent with the Digi-Key obsolete reading.

An unconsidered maker: P2's Cell balancing shortlist and drops for R7 name only Texas Instruments and Analog Devices/Maxim (MAX17320) parts, plus MPS (not allowed). ISL94212 (FN7938 Rev 1.00, fetched via https://jlcpcb.com/api/file/downloadByFileSystemAccessId/8590408951100973056, read 2026-09-29T17:04:53Z-ish) is a 1-to-12-series-cell balancing/monitoring IC with one external balance-FET gate driver per cell (CBn pins, p.407, 2123-2124), so the 50 mA of V142 is set by the external FET/resistor choice, the same pattern already used to qualify the rank-2 BQ29209's external balancing mode -- not an IC ceiling. It needs a host controller over its SPI interface to run its Manual/Timed/Auto Balance modes (Section on Auto Balance, p.2357-2384), so like the BQ76907 already noted as an unranked survivor it is host-controlled, not autonomous from NVM as the rank-1 MAX17320 is, and it has no built-in overcurrent or short-circuit protection, so it would still need a separate Pack overcurrent protection part. Its own reduced-cell-count application examples (Section 'Operating the ISL94212 with Reduced Cell Counts', p.6022-6060, Figures 54-56) stop at 6 cells; operation at exactly 2 series cells, the bench pack's count, is not shown or confirmed in the datasheet even though the JLCPCB/Renesas marketing figure states '1~12' cells. It fails sourcing rule 4 outright: JLCPCB stockCount 6, canPresaleNumber 6 at C3681518 (jlcpcb.py, read 2026-09-29T17:10:04Z) against the 50-unit S4 gate; the only other stocked variant in jlcparts, C123714, read stockCount 0 in the 2026-09-14 snapshot. Digi-Key was not read for this part because it does not clearly pass every requirement value (the 2-cell operation is unconfirmed).

missed.part: EVE INR18650/30P (no LCSC; off-board part under rule 1)
missed.why: P2's Pack cells drops exclude Samsung SDI, LG Energy Solution, EVE and Panasonic as whole makers with the single reason 'no cell product page reached on their sites' (2026-09-29T09:45:37Z-09:47:14Z), without checking the actual selling vendor. V151 already established Liion Wholesale as the vendor that counts for rules 4 and 5 (used for the selected Molicel INR-18650-P30B). That vendor's own product catalogue (https://liionwholesale.com/products.json, read 2026-09-29T17:08* ) lists six EVE-branded 18650 SKUs, an allowlisted S9 maker P2 never actually reached. One of them, EVE INR18650/30P, states on its own product page (https://liionwholesale.com/products/eve-inr18650-30p-10a-3000mah-flat-top-18650-battery-wholesale-discount.js, read 2026-09-29T17:09:35Z-ish) a manufacturer-rated 30 A (10C) maximum continuous discharge at a 75 degC cutoff and a manufacturer-rated minimum capacity of 2900 mAh, nominal 3.6 V / peak 4.2 V -- the discharge figure clears the 12.23 A pack-current row and the capacity figure meets the 2900 mAh minimum of V145, unlike every other EVE SKU at that vendor (INR18650/33V, /29V, /35V, ICR18650/26V), which are all rated 7.5-10 A and fail the discharge row the same way the dropped Molicel M30A/M35A did. It fails sourcing rule 4 at read time, though: the SKU's own Shopify product feed gives inventory_quantity -2 and available:false, the same stock-failure pattern (negative/zero inventory, available false) that already dropped the Molicel P26A and P28A SKUs at this vendor. No EVE manufacturer datasheet was reached (EVE's own site could not be located from the tree), so the charge-voltage, charge-current, and charge/discharge temperature rows are not independently confirmed for this cell, only the vendor's own product-page figures above.
